title: FFmpeg Static Wrapper Binary Missing Executable Bit (+x)
root_cause: The static FFmpeg 7.0.2 binary was committed and deployed with mode 100644 (-rw-rw-rw-). Mounted read-only into encore-worker at /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg:ro, Java process executor threw Exec failed, error: 13 (Permission denied) on all transcoding tasks.
evidence: jobs 9705d7ec, ba3c1d1f, 631edaf8, a7143db6, 0d6c2c4b all failed on 2026-11-04 with error: 13 (Permission denied).
proposed_fix: chmod +x deploy/wrapper/ffmpeg and update git index with git update-index --chmod=+x deploy/wrapper/ffmpeg.

title: Ungraceful Bot Shutdown & Resource Leak of Background Tasks and HTTP Runners
root_cause: On application termination, poller_loop, sweep_loop, and fingerprinter background tasks were never cancelled before closing the database pool and redis client, causing InterfaceError in asyncpg. Furthermore, aiohttp web runners and bot.session were not cleaned up.
evidence: In main() finally: block, only encre.aclose(), redis_client.aclose(), and db.close() were called.
proposed_fix: Cancel all background tasks, gather them with return_exceptions=True, cleanup api_runners, and close bot.session in finally block.
regression_test: Validated in bot.py lifecycle shutdown sequence

title: Subprocess Failures / Timeouts Leave Corrupt Destination Files on Disk
root_cause: remux_to_mp4, download_thumbnail, and extract_thumbnail did not unlink destination files when FFmpeg failed or timed out, leaving 0-byte or corrupted partial files on disk.
evidence: Inspect media.py lines 340-385 where proc.returncode != 0 raised MediaError without unlinking dst.
proposed_fix: Add Path(dst).unlink(missing_ok=True) in timeout and returncode != 0 branches.

title: Silent Background Task Exceptions in JobEngine.spawn
root_cause: JobEngine.spawn added only self._bg_tasks.discard to task done callbacks. Coroutine exceptions were never retrieved or logged, masking silent failures in background operations.
proposed_fix: Add _on_done callback checking not t.cancelled() and logging t.exception().

title: Temporary Job Thumbnails Not Immediately Purged in _cleanup_job_dirs
root_cause: _delivery_thumbnail creates thumb-{job_id[:12]}.jpg in media_tmp. _cleanup_job_dirs purged media_incoming and media_out but omitted the temporary thumbnail, leaving it until periodic sweep.
evidence: _cleanup_job_dirs removed incoming and out but not tmp/thumb-{job_id[:12]}.jpg.

title: Source Path Inconsistency on Vanished Media Recovery
root_cause: When _refetch_source recreated a missing source file, it updated media_assets.sha256 but failed to update jobs.source_path in PostgreSQL. Subsequent retries would continue querying the defunct path.
evidence: engine.py:_refetch_source only executed UPDATE media_assets SET sha256.
proposed_fix: Add UPDATE jobs SET source_path = $2 WHERE id = $1.

title: Unchecked message.from_user Access in Admin Filter
root_cause: The _has_pending message filter directly accessed message.from_user.id. In channel posts or anonymous admin messages, message.from_user is None, causing AttributeError.
proposed_fix: Guard with if not message.from_user: return False.
regression_test: Validated filter syntax with None guard
